answer: What survives to the sparrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Every claim climbs the raven of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the zephyr re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
